production_model.label: Production model (locked) - final test metrics, unchanged

key_finding: Overall sensitivity (~0.76) hides large age heterogeneity at the locked threshold: ages 18-29 sensitivity is ~0.46 (women) / ~0.39 (men) versus ~0.93 / ~0.94 at ages 30-40, reflecting the pooled threshold applied to a population whose predicted risks differ with age. No subgroup-specific thresholds were created.

positioning: EarlyDia is a leakage-aware, cluster-aware, calibrated, sensitivity-oriented screening research prototype using NFHS-5 data, with explicit target-definition limitations, subgroup/error analysis, survey-aware descriptive analysis, decision-curve evaluation, and exploratory topological feature-space analysis.
